import argparse
import logging
import sys
from datetime import date

import crawlfunnel
from crawlfunnel.records import Listing

logger = logging.getLogger("listing_parser")


def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Parse a listing page")
    parser.add_argument("--page", default="listing.html")
    return parser


def parse(response):
    # Collects fields from XPath and CSS selectors into one record
    collector = crawlfunnel.FieldCollector(item=Listing(), response=response)
    collector.take_xpath("title", '//div[@class="listing_name"]')
    collector.take_xpath("title", '//div[@class="listing_heading"]')
    collector.take_xpath("amount", '//p[@id="amount"]')
    collector.take_css("availability", "p#availability")
    collector.put_literal("fetched_on", date.today().isoformat())  # literal values also work
    return collector.finish()


def main(argv=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        with open(args.page, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            html = handle.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        logger.error("Could not read page: %s", exc)
        return 1
    item = parse(crawlfunnel.Response(html))
    logger.info("Parsed item: %s", item)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import argparse
import logging
import sys

import rowbinder

logger = logging.getLogger("rename_users")

RENAMES = [
    {"prev_label": "rosa", "next_label": "amelia"},
    {"prev_label": "bruno", "next_label": "celeste"},
    {"prev_label": "nico", "next_label": "paz"},
]


def build_statement(table):
    # Parametrize the filter and the new value so one statement serves all rows.
    prev_slot = rowbinder.slot("prev_label")
    next_slot = rowbinder.slot("next_label")
    return rowbinder.patch_rows(table).filter(table.c.handle == prev_slot).set_values(handle=next_slot)


def apply_renames(engine, table, pairs):
    # Run the parametrized statement once per pair, inside a single transaction.
    stmt = build_statement(table)
    with engine.open_transaction() as conn:
        return conn.run(stmt, pairs)


def main(argv):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Bulk-rename users.")
    parser.add_argument("--url", default="sqlite:///users.db")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv[1:])
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    engine = rowbinder.connect(args.url)
    user_table = rowbinder.table("user_account", engine)
    result = apply_renames(engine, user_table, RENAMES)
    logger.info("rows affected: %s", result.rowcount)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

import argparse
import logging
import sys

import pulsedeck as deck

logger = logging.getLogger("orders_panel")


def build_parser():
    # Ruta del archivo dentro del bucket y tiempo de cache
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Mostrar pedidos desde un CSV")
    parser.add_argument("--link", default="warehouse-eu-north/orders_2026.csv")
    parser.add_argument("--ttl", type=int, default=600)
    return parser


def load_orders(link_name, ttl):
    # Abre la conexion y guarda el resultado en cache durante ttl segundos
    connection = deck.open_link("s3", kind=deck.FileLink)
    return connection.read(link_name, file_format="csv", cache_seconds=ttl)


def show_orders(orders):
    # Una linea por registro
    for record in orders.iter_records():
        deck.write(f"{record.customer} pidio {record.item}")

    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        orders = load_orders(args.link, args.ttl)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        logger.error("Archivo no encontrado: %s", exc)
        return 1
    show_orders(orders)
    logger.info("Registros mostrados")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
